tools.name: agent_readiness_scan
tools.description: Free check of how readable and usable a public website is for AI agents: llms.txt, robots.txt AI-crawler rules, sitemap, schema.org JSON-LD, MCP and x402 discovery, OpenAPI, and whether the page is readable without JavaScript. Returns a 0-100 score, a grade, and a fix list. Rate-limited to 10 scans
